affectedSurfaces: Antigravity CLI structured-output and raw-event translation
hypothesis: Removing a test-only duplicate OpenRouter tier map, naming the harness JSON-schema boundary, and using existing neutral JSON types for parsed output will eliminate copied configuration and strict-type ratchet regressions without changing preset resolution, model selection, structured-output validation, or Antigravity event behavior.

metricsCompared.name: copied OpenRouter laboratory tier catalogs
metricsCompared.baseline: One generated production constant duplicated the shipped preset tier mapping and was consumed only by literal-value tests.
metricsCompared.candidate: Zero test-only production tier maps remain; runtime preset tiers resolve directly through the capability catalog.

metricsCompared.name: strict-type policy regressions in affected harness files
metricsCompared.baseline: Three files exceeded or fell outside their raw unknown boundary baselines.
metricsCompared.candidate: A named AgentOutputSchema boundary plus existing neutral JSON object and value types describe schemas, results, and raw JSON frames without new raw unknown patterns.

rationale: The OpenRouter deletion removes an unused duplicate declaration rather than changing any selected model, and the harness edits name the output-schema boundary while narrowing parsed JSON results to KOTA-owned neutral JSON types. Preset lookup, capability resolution, output-schema transport, structured-result handling, and raw-event preservation remain behaviorally covered; the candidate grants no new model, tool, filesystem, network, or authorization behavior.
